summary: Inventory application deployed persistently on node2 and node3 at port 8080. node1 now load-balances HTTP port 80 across both backends. All nodes retained Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic and recovered successfully after sequential reboots.
actions_performed: Created and enabled the inventory-app systemd service on node2 and node3 using the installed Python 3 runtime.
Installed Ubuntu-supported nginx 1.24 on node1 and configured shared-state round-robin balancing.
Verified direct inventory health/data and alternating node2/node3 responses through node1.
Restarted node2, node3, and node1 sequentially; verified changed boot identities and complete recovery after each restart.
